cards.title: Discrepancy between Proposed MRT and Moment Theory (AUMC/AUC)
cards.claim: For Michaelis-Menten systems, the MRT calculated using the proposed method (based on Vss and Dose/AUC) differs from the MRT calculated using standard moment theory (AUMC/AUC).
conditions: Comparison of two distinct MRT calculation methodologies.
limitations: The magnitude of the difference is not quantified in the abstract.
The specific conditions under which one method is preferred over the other for regulatory or clinical decision-making are not explicitly stated beyond 'clarifying residence time derivations'.
cards.downstream_use: When analyzing nonlinear PK data, explicitly state which MRT definition is being used. Do not interchangeably use AUMC/AUC and the Vss/(Dose/AUC) derived MRT without acknowledging the theoretical difference demonstrated in this source.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
